glosses: related by marriage; in-law; excluding one’s own spouse and, often, the spouses of one’s blood relatives

examples.text: Ich bin mit ihr verschwägert, weil ihr Bruder mit meiner Schwester verheiratet ist.
examples.translation: I am related to her by marriage, because her brother is married to my sister.
